feedback: deterministic, grounding, and model story critics accept

findings.detail: name questions must request the full name explicitly
opening paragraph must read as narration, not an ID table
Deterministic grounding reports that all required visible facts are assigned once and sentence-anchored.
The material is coherent prose in paragraphs, not an explicit table, bullet ledger, or personnel-index wall.
Each named person's status for each of the six streams is stated consistently; the counterfactual changes are clearly framed as hypothetical rather than conflicting record facts.
The story supplies the accepted tally and qualification rule but does not assert which named person is the bearer; the reader must reconstruct and compute it.
The main, intermediate, counterfactual, and scalar questions are unambiguous and their required evidence is available in the narration.
